theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (w : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), Continuous Φ → Injective Φ → (∀ y ∈ N, ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclid P), B ⊆ W ∩ N → MeasurableSet B → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ z in Φ '' B, g z ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in B, w x * g (Φ x) ∂μ) → ∀ B : Set (Euclid P), B ⊆ N → MeasurableSet B → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ z in Φ '' B, g z ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in B, w x * g (Φ x) ∂μ
